tools.name: T480 WSL Lab
tools.description: Governed SSH access from the T16 to fixed Windows and Ubuntu operations on the T480.
secrets_required: SSH key available through the local SSH agent or configuration
verification: Run verify against the selected operation after execution.
Require explicit operator approval before a mutating operation.
Promote this tool to approved only after a successful T480 preflight and health operation.

tools.name: T480 n8n Workflow Adapter
tools.description: AF-derived adapter for importing, activating, listing, and inspecting workflows in the private n8n instance on the T480.
secrets_required: T480-local n8n API key file; never a T16 or Git-tracked secret
verification: Run preflight after M2 starts n8n and an operator creates the T480-local API key.
Import a bounded test workflow only with explicit approval.
Capture an operator-visible workflow execution and raw evidence bundle before promoting the tool.

tools.name: T480 PostgreSQL + pgvector Adapter
tools.description: AF-Supabase-modelled adapter for the private PostgreSQL and pgvector service on the T480.
secrets_required: T480-local Compose .env; never a T16 or Git-tracked database password
verification: Run preflight and inspect after M2 deployment.
Run vector-probe to prove the installed pgvector extension executes a real distance calculation.
Apply only a reviewed migration file with explicit approval and capture independent T480 evidence.
